# netactuate_cloud_private_images (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Private Images visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_private_images" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_images` (List of Object) Private images available to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_images))
